heading: Tag in El Retiro
title: Tag in El Retiro · a 3D game made with Neblla
desc: A game of tag in a Madrid park, with your Neblla doll. Don't get caught: whoever is it when the whistle blows loses. Made with Mundo, Neblla's 3D engine.
intro: An afternoon in the park with Lucía, Mateo, Sofía and Diego. Whoever is it chases the others; if they touch you, you're it. Touch someone else to pass it on. After one minute the whistle blows: whoever is it then loses, and whoever was it for the least time wins.
keys: Move with <kbd>WASD</kbd> or the arrow keys, run with <kbd>Shift</kbd> and jump with <kbd>Space</kbd>. On a phone, use the joystick and the jump button.
doll: You're playing with the default doll. Make your own in Neblla Creator and it will show up here.
endLost: You were it at the end. Run faster next time.
endWon: You were it for {time}. Nobody was it for less time than you.
endOther: You were it for {time}. {name} won, having been it for {winTime}.
needWorld: This game needs the Mundo module turned on.
